/* Featured Report - Blue */
.featured-report-blue {
background: #dce8f7 !important;
border: 2px solid #0072ce !important;
border-radius: 8px;
box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0, 114, 206, 0.10);
}


.featured-report-blue:hover {
background: #d2e3f6 !important;
box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0, 114, 206, 0.15);
}


/* Featured Report - Copper */
.featured-report-copper {
background: #ead8c1 !important;
border: 2px solid #b87333 !important;
border-radius: 8px;
box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(184, 115, 51, 0.12);
}


.featured-report-copper:hover {
background: #e2ccb0 !important;
box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(184, 115, 51, 0.18);
}


.featured-report .report-title {
font-weight: 700;
}


/*SUSTAINABILITY REPORT FEATURE */


.report-meta {
display: flex;
justify-content: space-between;
align-items: center;
gap: 20px;
}


.report-languages {
margin-left: auto;
text-align: right;
}


.sustainability-report-box {
padding: 14px 18px;
margin-bottom: 8px;
border-radius: 8px;
transition: all .25s ease;
border-left: none;


}


.sustainability-report-box:hover {
background: #eaf3fc;
transform: translateY(-3px);
box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
}


/* Icon */


.sustainability-report-box .report-icon {
width: 48px;
height: 48px;
flex-shrink: 0;


display: flex;
align-items: center;
justify-content: center;


background: #e6f0fa;
border-radius: 50%;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-icon svg {
width: 24px;
height: 24px;


stroke: #0072ce;
stroke-width: 1.8;
fill: none;
}


/* Content */


.sustainability-report-box .report-content {
flex: 1;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-title {
font-size: 16px;
font-weight: 600;
color: #1f2a44;
margin-bottom: 6px;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-desc {
font-size: 14px;
line-height: 1.5;
color: #4a5568;
margin-bottom: 10px;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-languages {
font-size: 14px;
color: #4a5568;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-languages a {
color: #0072ce;
font-weight: 600;
text-decoration: none;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-languages a:hover {
text-decoration: underline;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-languages span {
margin: 0 8px;
color: #0072ce;
}


.accordion-content .sustainability-report-box:nth-child(odd) {
background: #f2f7fd;
}


.accordion-content .sustainability-report-box:nth-child(even) {
background: #f6f1e8;
}


.accordion-content .sustainability-report-box:nth-child(odd):hover {
background: #dce8f7;
}


.accordion-content .sustainability-report-box:nth-child(even):hover {
background: #ede4d4;
}


.sustainability-report-box:hover {
transform: translateY(-3px);
box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.06);
}


/* Mobile */


@media (max-width: 767px) {


.sustainability-report-box {
align-items: flex-start;
padding: 20px;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-icon {
width: 40px;
height: 40px;
}


.sustainability-report-box .report-title {
font-size: 16px;
}


}
